choices.content: Draw an open circle at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the right.
Draw a filled dot at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the left.
Draw a filled dot at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the right.
Draw an open circle at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the left.

question.prompt: Represent \(x\ge-1\) on a number line. Which description of how to draw it is correct?

solutions.explanation: Use a filled dot when equality is included. Since \(x\) is greater than or equal to \(-1\), the ray extends to the right.
solutions.title: Identify the endpoint and ray direction
